purpose: Bounded exact-ID geometry diagnostic for one strict-overlap pair from root Surat acceptance; no acceptance/catalog/tolerance changes.

source.queryMethod: existing createParcelSource(...).queryIds(two exact IDs) using existing createHttpsJsonFetch and published source-scoped Sectigo intermediate

interpretation: The exact fresh geometries intersect by 0.2394 m², only 0.0046% of Piplod and 0.0064% of Umra North. The intersection is a single narrow boundary sliver with approximately 9 mm minimum oriented width and about 53 m supporting edge; this is consistent with a sub-centimeter edge-position mismatch, not a substantive parcel overlap. It remains a one-pair anomaly; keep original acceptance result and do not apply a global tolerance or reject either parcel based on this diagnosis alone.

measurementMethod.lookup: Fresh source.queryIds for the two exact canonical IDs; descriptor filters status=Final, city=Surat, authority=SMC; complete=true, both IDs present.
measurementMethod.intersection: @turf/turf 6.x intersect(a,b), then @turf/turf area() in square metres.
measurementMethod.projection: Project WGS84 [longitude,latitude] positions with proj4 EPSG:4326 to EPSG:32643; compute planar polygon areas with shoelace exterior-minus-holes.
measurementMethod.minimumOrientedWidth: For the projected intersection exterior, construct the convex hull and scan projection ranges on each hull-edge normal; report the smallest range. This is the convex-polygon minimum caliper width.
